submitted.rationale: Mg–Sb–O phases (MgO, Mg2Sb2O7, MgSb2O6) have wide band gaps, well above 2.4 eV, so I expected little photoresponse at 2.4 eV anywhere on the line. I measured five compositions spread across the line (Sb fraction 0.10, 0.32, 0.49, 0.67, 0.80). All five gave EQE of about zero or slightly negative, so they are effectively inactive. Index 2 had the highest value (-0.00002%), but the gaps between the five are within noise.

rejected.reason: MgSb2O6 composition; EQE -0.00063%, wide-gap and inactive at 2.4 eV
